card.name: Inside words in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: Words or word parts written in ALL CAPS inside boxed-warning headings, often partway through a medical term like MYASTHENIA, INDIVIDUALS or MICROANGIOPATHY. Also the word BE in 'SHOULD BE CONSIDERED'.

modes.label: Partway through capitalized terms
modes.description: Middle or end of a long medical word in an all-caps warning heading.

modes.label: Short word in capitalized sentence
modes.description: The word BE in an all-caps warning sentence about diagnosis.
modes.example: ASSOCIATED ANEMIA SHOULD<< BE>> CONSIDERED AND THE DRUG

card.plain: It fires on pieces of long medical words in all-capital warning headings.
